newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi says foreign refining capacity at 1.5 mln bp.
newsitem.headline: Saudi says foreign refining capacity at 1.5 mln bp.

text.p: Saudi oil refining capacity abroad stands at 1.5 million barrels per day, Saudi Oil Minister Ali bin Ibrahim al-Naimi said.

"The amount of Saudi oil being refined at foreign refineries in which Saudi Arabia holds a share stands currently at about 1.5 million barrels per day," said Naimi, quoted by the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) late on Thursday.
Saudi Arabia was making efforts to increase the capacity "in the near future", Naimi told SPA during a visit to the Philippines.
Naimi was speaking at a function held by the Philippines oil firm Petron, which is 40 percent owned by Saudi Arabia's state-owned Aramco.
Saudi Arabia has been discussing refinery stake deals in India, China and Portugal. Riyadh already has shares in refineries in the United States, South Korea, Greece and the Philippines.
